rules.NM: RB-NM-1: register criterion NOT_MEASURED on ≥ 50% of items ⇒ signal
rules.PM: RB-PM-1: production-metric NOT_MEASURED field recurring ≥ 2 ⇒ signal; RB-PM-2: open→last-commit share ≥ 0.5 ⇒ signal
rules.LINK: LINK-1: provider-authored declared table (DEDUP-1 precedent): the FIRST link whose regex matches the signal statement gives its key/components; registerItem / inFlight links make the signal a DUPLICATE of that existing item (it reinforces it, never re-creates it); a statement matching no link gets no component ⇒ the deny-by-default gate refuses it NO_COMPONENT_ATTACHED (never an invented target)
rules.EXT: RB-EXT-1: only ADMITTED external Radar observations are signals
rules.TOP: top 5 auto-selectable, not-superseded proposals by the existing selector ranking get a contract draft
rules.SUP: SUP-1: a proposal is SUPERSEDED iff its key is in the declared SUPERSEDED table AND the cited artifact exists in the repository (injected ctx.artifactExists); superseded proposals stay listed (supersededBy = delivering PRs + artifact) but never enter top or a conversion; no artifact (or no predicate) ⇒ NOT superseded
rules.CONV: RB-CONV-1: walk `top` (selector rank order, superseded already excluded) and convert the first N eligible drafts; a draft is SKIPPED when: SUPERSEDED (SUP-1) · DUPLICATE (its id is already a contract scenario or a register item id, or names an in-flight build / IN_FLIGHT link) · OWNER_GATED (engine gate or draft.ownerGate.required) · NO_DECLARED_OBJECTIVE (objective NOT_DERIVED) · NO_WRITE_SET_ESTIMATE · OWN1_MATCH (the contract text would trip the register's OWN-1 owner rule ⇒ never silently converted). RB-CONV-2: only with opts.convertOwnerGated, a draft declaring ownerGate {required, step} is converted with the step written into missingForPass so the register's OWN-1 marks it requiresOwnerAuthorization (visible, never auto-selectable). One batch id per conversion: a batch already present in the contracts file ⇒ ALREADY_CONVERTED, nothing appended (idempotent). Append-only: existing entries are never rewritten; only the header count / initialStatusCounts are recomputed from the array.

invariants: composition only: reuses odg-radar-to-mission-loop (gate+dedup), mission-priority-selector (ranking with the register's WEIGHTS/DIRECTIONS), odg-strategic-register (CRITERIA, CRC-1), change-impact-graph (multiplier) — no second radar/scheduler/registry/formula
every signal cites a committed source pointer; external observations only when ADMITTED
deny-by-default: nothing authorized, nothing executed; owner questions ⇒ OWNER_GATED; duplicates of register items / contracts / in-flight builds reinforce them, never re-create them
unknown cost/benefit ⇒ NOT_MEASURED; write_set is an ESTIMATE; score ≠ authorization; hypothesis ≠ fact
pure: no file write, no network, no store; deterministic given the injected sources, graph and epochs

freshness.rule: now = newest source epoch (no wall clock); each source's epoch is pinned in inputs[].epochMs and re-dated from local git (last commit time; current commit time if uncommitted) only when its sha256 changes; a signal whose source is older than odg-radar-to-mission-loop.FRESHNESS_DAYS is refused EXPIRED
